notes: SVGBackend::with_string at the given size, fill(WHITE), ChartBuilder with a margin and label areas, build_cartesian_2d over the data's ranges (computed inside the call; plotters takes them from the caller), configure_mesh().draw(), one LineSeries per series in Palette99 colours, present(); returns the SVG text. plotters places every vertex on a whole pixel, so the lines are up to 0.52 px from one affine mapping of the data, within the one-pixel limit.
details: plotters' backend coordinates are integers (BackendCoord is (i32, i32)), so each polyline vertex is rounded to a whole pixel. The worst distance from the least-squares mapping is 0.503 to 0.519 px over the six fixtures; libraries that write fractional coordinates are within 0.06 px. No option of the SVG backend writes fractional coordinates. Default features (axis labels use system fonts through font-kit).
